quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings 10-Q: in connection with Gulf Island and continued investment in capacity, IES raised its fiscal 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $145 million to $160 million; nine-month capex was $123.0 million, including the acquisition of the real property and related assets of Broadwind Heavy Fabrications' production facility in Abilene, Texas. Custom Engineered Solutions revenue was $179,510 thousand in the June 2026 quarter versus $105,780 thousand a year earlier; of $2,801,635 thousand of remaining performance obligations at June 30, 2026, about $2,289,343 thousand is expected within 12 months. IES expects working capital needs to rise through the first quarter of fiscal 2027 as Infrastructure Solutions backlog, which is not progress billed, grows; firm material purchase commitments were $12.7 million.
